# Eco-Loom

> Eco-Loom is a carbon accounting and ESG operations platform that helps sustainability teams organize emissions data, track Scope 1–3 activity, and prepare useful reporting.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/): Carbon visibility for every site.
- [Features](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/features): Emissions data intake, dashboards, stakeholder reporting, and progress tracking.
- [How it works](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/how-it-works): The emissions data-to-action workflow.
- [Why Eco-Loom](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/why-eco-loom): Product approach and benefits.
- [Pricing](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/pricing): Plans and pricing information.
- [About](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/about): About Eco-Loom.
- [Contact](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/contact): Contact information.
- [Blog](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/blog): Carbon accounting and sustainability guidance.
- [Privacy](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/terms): Terms of service.
- [Security](https://eco-loom-esg.vercel.app/security): Security overview.
